definitions.explanation: A female server in a restaurant or café who takes orders and serves food and drinks to customers.

examples.japanese: ウェイトレスがメニューを{持|も}ってきた。
レストランでウェイトレスとして{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work as a waitress at a restaurant.

examples.japanese: ウェイトレスに{水|みず}を{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I asked the waitress for water.

notes:
A loanword from English referring to a female restaurant server.

USAGE NOTES:
- In modern Japanese, gender-neutral terms are increasingly preferred:
  - ホールスタッフ (floor staff)
  - {店員|てんいん} (shop/restaurant staff)
  - サーバー (server)
- ウェイトレス/ウェイター are still understood but becoming less common in job listings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ウェイトレスを{呼|よ}ぶ (to call the waitress)
- ウェイトレスに{注文|ちゅうもん}する (to order from the waitress)
- ウェイトレスとして{働|はたら}く (to work as a waitress)

RELATED WORDS:
- ウェイター (waiter)
- {給仕|きゅうじ} (waiter/waitress - older/formal term)
- {仲居|なかい} (waitress at a Japanese inn/restaurant)
